assumptions: No explicit requirement ID/prefix was given in the source text; used the stated 'REQ-042' identifier from the document heading.
Assumed the system does not reveal whether an email is registered when a reset is requested for an unregistered address (BR-6), as the requirement is silent on this.
Assumed reset links are single-use and rejected if reused (BR-7); the requirement does not explicitly state this.
Assumed the failed-attempt lockout (BR-5) is scoped per account/email and lifts automatically once the one-hour window elapses (BR-8); the requirement does not specify the scope or reset mechanism.
Assumed no upper bound or character-composition rule exists for the new password beyond the 12-character minimum, since none is stated.
Assumed the reset-request form performs basic email format validation, as this is standard practice but not explicitly stated.
Split SC-16 (account states) into two distinct test cases (active vs. locked/disabled account) since these are genuinely different data conditions.
Split SC-17 (email format variations) into two distinct test cases (mixed-case domain and plus-addressing) since these are genuinely different data variations.

For SC-16 locked/disabled account case, assumed the system rejects the reset request or shows a generic error rather than sending a link, since the requirement does not state behaviour for non-active accounts.

Assumed a reset link generated exactly 30 minutes ago is still valid (not yet expired), interpreting 'expires after 30 minutes' as remaining valid up to and including the 30-minute mark and becoming invalid only once that duration is exceeded; the requirement does not state the exact boundary behaviour.

Assumed the system performs exact (non-normalized) matching of the submitted email against the registered email, so plus-addressing variants (e.g. 'user+tag@example.com') are treated as not matching the base registered address, since the requirement does not state any email normalization or alias-matching behaviour.

test_cases.title: Registered user requests reset link with valid registered email
preconditions: A user account exists and is registered with email 'user@example.com'
steps: Navigate to the password reset request page
Enter 'user@example.com' in the Email field
Submit the reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: A password reset link is generated and sent to 'user@example.com', and a confirmation message is displayed to the user

test_cases.title: User follows valid unexpired reset link and sets a compliant new password
preconditions: A registered user has requested a password reset and received a valid reset link that is less than 30 minutes old
steps: Open the reset link received in email
Enter 'NewSecurePass123' in the New Password field
Confirm the new password and submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The password is updated successfully, a confirmation message is shown, and the user can log in with the new password

test_cases.title: User requests password reset with an unregistered email address
preconditions: No user account is registered with email 'unknown@example.com'
steps: Navigate to the password reset request page
Enter 'unknown@example.com' in the Email field
Submit the reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: No reset email is sent, and a generic confirmation message is displayed that does not reveal whether the email is registered

test_cases.title: User attempts to use a reset link after it has expired (more than 30 minutes old)
preconditions: A registered user has a reset link that was generated 31 minutes ago
steps: Wait until the reset link is 31 minutes old
Open the expired reset link
Enter a valid new password and submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the request with an 'expired link' error message, and the password is not changed

test_cases.title: User attempts to use a reset link at exactly the 30-minute expiry boundary
preconditions: A registered user has a reset link that was generated exactly 30 minutes ago
steps: Wait until the reset link is exactly 30 minutes old
Open the reset link
Enter a valid new password and submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: Since the link 'expires after 30 minutes', it is still considered valid at exactly the 30-minute mark; the system accepts the link, allows the new password to be submitted, and the password is updated successfully

test_cases.title: User submits a new password of 11 characters, one below the minimum length
preconditions: A registered user has a valid, unexpired reset link open
steps: Open the reset link received in email
Enter the 11-character password 'Abcdefgh12!' in the New Password field
Submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the password with a validation error stating the minimum length of 12 characters is required, and the password is not changed

test_cases.title: User submits a new password of exactly 12 characters, the stated minimum length
preconditions: A registered user has a valid, unexpired reset link open
steps: Open the reset link received in email
Enter the 12-character password 'Abcdefgh123!' in the New Password field
Submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The system accepts the password since it meets the 12-character minimum, and the password is updated successfully

test_cases.title: User submits an empty new password value on the reset form
preconditions: A registered user has a valid, unexpired reset link open
steps: Open the reset link received in email
Leave the New Password field empty
Submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays a required-field validation error and does not update the password

test_cases.title: User submits a malformed email address on the reset-request form
preconditions: The password reset request page is accessible
steps: Navigate to the password reset request page
Enter 'not-an-email' in the Email field
Submit the reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays a validation error indicating the email format is invalid, and no reset email is sent

test_cases.title: User submits a new password identical to the current/previous password
preconditions: A registered user's current password is 'CurrentPass123'
The user has a valid, unexpired reset link open
steps: Open the reset link received in email
Enter 'CurrentPass123' in the New Password field
Submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the password with an error stating the new password must differ from the previous password, and the password is not changed

test_cases.title: Fourth reset attempt within one hour is blocked after three failed attempts
preconditions: A registered user has already made three failed password reset attempts within the past hour
steps: Attempt a fourth password reset using an invalid link or invalid password within the same one-hour window
Submit the fourth attempt
test_cases.expected_result: The system blocks the fourth attempt with a message stating further attempts are temporarily blocked, and no password change occurs

test_cases.title: Reset attempt is permitted again after the one-hour lockout window elapses
preconditions: A registered user was blocked after three failed reset attempts within the past hour
More than one hour has elapsed since the first of the three failed attempts
steps: Wait until the one-hour lockout window has elapsed
Request a new password reset link for the account
Follow the new link and submit a valid new password
test_cases.expected_result: The reset attempt is permitted, the reset link is sent or accepted, and the password can be changed successfully

test_cases.title: User attempts to reuse a reset link that has already been successfully consumed
preconditions: A registered user has already successfully completed a password reset using a specific reset link
steps: Open the same reset link a second time
Enter a valid new password and submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the request with an 'invalid or already used link' error message, and the password is not changed

test_cases.title: User submits a tampered/invalid reset token in the URL
preconditions: A password reset link URL format is known
steps: Modify the reset token portion of a valid reset link URL to an arbitrary invalid value
Open the tampered link
Enter a valid new password and submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the request with an 'invalid link' error message, and the password is not changed

test_cases.title: Password reset succeeds for a registered email with an active account
preconditions: A user account is registered, active, and email 'active.user@example.com' is confirmed
steps: Navigate to the password reset request page
Enter 'active.user@example.com' in the Email field
Submit the reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: A reset link is sent to the active account's registered email, and the confirmation message is displayed

test_cases.title: Password reset request for a registered email with a locked/disabled account
preconditions: A user account is registered but is in a locked/disabled state with email 'locked.user@example.com'
steps: Navigate to the password reset request page
Enter 'locked.user@example.com' in the Email field
Submit the reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: No usable reset link is sent for the locked/disabled account, and the same generic message used for unregistered emails (which does not reveal account status) is displayed to the user

test_cases.title: Password reset request with mixed-case domain in the registered email
preconditions: A user account is registered with email 'user@Example.com'
steps: Navigate to the password reset request page
Enter 'user@EXAMPLE.com' in the Email field
Submit the reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: The system matches the mixed-case domain to the registered account and sends the reset link successfully

test_cases.title: Password reset request with plus-addressing variant of the registered email
preconditions: A user account is registered with email 'user@example.com'
steps: Navigate to the password reset request page
Enter 'user+tag@example.com' in the Email field
Submit the reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: The system treats 'user+tag@example.com' as a distinct string that does not match the registered account 'user@example.com'; no reset link is sent to the registered account, and the same generic non-disclosure message used for unregistered emails is displayed

test_cases.title: Failed attempts spread across separate hourly windows do not trigger the lockout
preconditions: A registered user's account currently has zero failed password reset attempts recorded
steps: Perform a first failed password reset attempt at time T=0
Wait until more than one hour has elapsed since the first attempt
Perform a second failed password reset attempt at time T greater than 1 hour
Perform a third failed password reset attempt shortly after the second attempt
Attempt a fourth password reset immediately after the third attempt
test_cases.expected_result: Because the first failed attempt falls outside the rolling one-hour window relative to the later attempts, no rolling one-hour window ever contains three failed attempts; the fourth attempt is processed normally (not blocked) rather than triggering the BR-5 lockout
